- **Tar spot** (ruled out): Raised black stromata embedded in tissue — completely different appearance
- **Physoderma brown spot** (ruled out): Tan/yellow banded spots with dark midrib lesions — not orange pustules
- **Gray leaf spot** (ruled out): Rectangular, vein-limited lesions — different morphology
- **Eyespot** (ruled out): Circular spots with distinct yellow halos — not the same type of lesion

The test image clearly shows the hallmark of Southern rust: small, densely packed, light orange pustules concentrated on the upper leaf surface.
